readyOnClose: {app} {version} is ready: it will be installed when you close the program.
skipFailed: Couldn’t save your choice: version {version} will be offered again. You can try again later.
skipped: Version {version} will no longer be offered at startup. You can still install it from the Help menu with Check for updates.

available.title: {app} {version} is available
available.subtitle: You’re using version {version}.
available.noNotes: No release notes were written for this version.
available.explain: With “Update now”, StarLight downloads the new version, closes, installs it and reopens on its own. With “Later”, it downloads it in the background and installs it when you close the program. Your projects, images and settings stay as they are.

downloading.title: Downloading {app} {version}
downloading.subtitleNow: When it’s done, StarLight lets you know, then closes, installs the new version and reopens on its own.
downloading.subtitleLater: When it’s done, the new version will be installed when you close StarLight.
downloading.keepWorking: You can keep working: the download continues even if you close this window.

ready.title: {app} {version} is ready to install
ready.countdownBefore: StarLight will close and restart in
ready.subtitle: Installation takes less than a minute and asks no questions.
ready.unsavedWork: You have unsaved changes. Save the project and press “Install and restart” again, or choose “Later”: the new version will be installed when you close StarLight.
ready.development: StarLight is running from source: installation is only simulated and changes nothing.
ready.noteCountdown: If you’re working on something you haven’t saved, choose “Later”: the new version will be installed when you close StarLight.
ready.note: With “Install and restart”, StarLight closes, installs the new version and reopens on its own. With “Later”, it installs it when you close the program.

checking.title: Checking for updates
checking.body: StarLight is asking the server whether a new version is available…
